title: EUC+
author: Digitorsion
description: EUC+ v0.1: T-1-style generated notes on top of the stock Euclidean sequencer. On Euclid hits without parameter locks, audio and MIDI tracks play notes chosen from a pool of scale degrees in the pattern's KB SCALE and ROOT NOTE, moved by a phrase shape and a seeded, lockable random sequence. Settings in RAM (eup_cfg); no UI yet.
